heading: Tell me what you're building.
subtext: Whether it's a content brief, a partnership idea, or a styling question — select what fits best and send a short note. I read every message myself.
form_note: This opens a pre-filled email in your own email app — nothing is stored or sent from this page directly.

faq.question: What services do you offer?
faq.answer: Three things, working together: content strategy and copywriting for fashion/luxury brands, brand partnership collaborations, and one-on-one personal styling guidance.

faq.question: How do I start a project with you?
faq.answer: Select the inquiry type above and send a short brief — what you're working on, what you need, and your timeline. I typically respond within 24–48 hours.

faq.question: Do you work with brands outside fashion and luxury?
faq.answer: My core expertise is fashion, luxury, and lifestyle — but I'm open to adjacent spaces (entertainment, sports, beauty) where strategic content and brand voice matter just as much.

faq.question: What does a styling session actually involve?
faq.answer: A conversation about your current wardrobe, your goals, and your lifestyle, followed by practical, personalized guidance — not a generic style quiz.

faq.question: Can we collaborate on an ongoing basis?
faq.answer: Yes — ongoing partnerships are actively welcome, whether that's a content retainer, a recurring brand collaboration, or continued styling support.
